verdict.rationale: The docs have a dedicated 'Feeds' guide, which points to inbound ingestion from external sources, but the pack gives only the title. The detailed ingestion evidence is Warehouse Sync, which pulls data from your own Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery or Databricks warehouse rather than from third-party cloud apps. Missing for 10: any detail on which third-party cloud apps or partner feeds can send data in, how a feed is configured, and independent or hands-on confirmation of third-party ingestion.
